point: px=(x1+x2)/2, py=(y1+y2)/2 of each final source-px box; never moved, shrunk or chosen using labels

primary.name: etiket kutusu içine nokta isabeti (point inside the labelled box)
primary.matching: one-to-one; maximum-cardinality then minimum total normalized centre distance: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on cost = d_norm - 1e6 for feasible pairs and 0 for infeasible pairs, keeping only feasible assigned pairs
primary.tieBreak: linear_sum_assignment is deterministic for a fixed matrix; rows = targets in manifest order, columns = predictions in stored order; remaining exact ties resolved by that order

secondary.matching: same assignment with feasibility d_norm <= tol
secondary.note: sensitivity analysis only, not an acceptance threshold

iou.matching: greedy one-to-one by descending IoU as in the earlier evaluations (recomputed and checked against the stored scores)

falsePoints.rule: prediction point inside a reviewed mask: frozen clean-skin ROI on positive photos, reviewed Clear mask on Clear negative photos; reported separately
falsePoints.conflict: a point inside the mask AND inside any source positive box is a conflict: recorded and left UNKNOWN (ROIs were built excluding every source box dilated by max(10px, side), so none are expected)
falsePoints.unknown: all other unmatched points are UNKNOWN, never counted as right or wrong

duplicates: reported: extra points inside an already matched target box (same lesion counted once); distinct lesions found = matched targets; no new merging or filtering
comparison: every model x input mode is its own row; no best-mode selection; Step0 on the same 28 photos / 201 targets
